## 3. Transition tables

Eventual shares (published table) are the published table and tail from month 0 (`eventualProbabilities`; possibly θ-scaled or laddered), project-weighted. The two raw columns are the Aalen–Johansen incidence at the end of observation of the pathway’s own spells in the pooled window (preApplication: all pathways), with no tail: unweighted (each spell counts once) and unit-weighted (each spell weighted by its net units). Comparing the raw pair shows the effect of weighting; comparing the published table with the unweighted column shows the effect of the table construction and tail.

## 4. Construction duration: TCO versus completed_date

Over 4 completed histories with a construction start and permit rows with a `complete_day`: median construction duration to the history's completion (first TCO/CFC, else permit `completed_date`) = 882.5 days (28.9944 months); to the earliest permit `complete_day` = 882.5 days (28.9944 months); difference 0 days. The medians hide the cases where the two dates differ: 0 of them have a completion day different from the earliest permit `complete_day`; paired median of (history completion − earliest permit `complete_day`) over them = none days. TCO data start in 2018, so earlier completions are dated later.

## 10. Data-quality rules (sc.*) and method counts

The `fired` and `of` counts `recordQuality` writes into report.json; the top-25 record lists are in `quality-report.md`.

| id | label | tier | action | fired | of | share |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| sc.stages.gap-impute | A missing stage between two recorded stages takes the next recorded stage's date | 2 | default | 0 | 24 | 0% |
| sc.stages.no-fcd-duration | A completed project with no recorded construction start counts as finished, but not in the time spent in permit and construction | 2 | drop | 0 | 24 | 0% |
| sc.stages.running-max | Stage dates made non-decreasing (re-check of the project records' clamp) | 2 | replace | 0 | 25 | 0% |
| sc.exit.last-stage | An exit is placed at the last stage the project entered, no earlier than that stage's start | 2 | replace | 0 | 7 | 0% |
| sc.exit.purge-censor | An exit inside an administrative purge window counts as still open, not as a project decision | 4 | replace | 0 | 6 | 0% |
| sc.revision.ratio-clamp | A resize outside 0.25× to 3× is clamped to that range | 4 | replace | 0 | 0 | none |

sc.exit.purge-censor, unwindowed (all qualifying exits): 0 censored of 7 exits; 0 purge windows.
